decision: L1 -> L2 for the explicitly scoped endpoint and lineage facts
evidence_target: EXECUTION section 3: >=20 samples/scenes per condition with intervals and confound audit, not a claim of >=3 training seeds

checks.reason: Native, all-slot and replay controls are bit exact. BF16 program is fixed; FP32 differences reported separately. Effects substantially exceed replay noise.
Constant expert R/S oracles, real zero-L9 positive controls, source provenance checks, causal RC mask and candidate-permutation tests pass.
All fixed 64 language windows, 3 random probes, and 128 prospectively selected task questions retained. Task selectors use validation only.
Absolute quality and changes from the same full model are both reported. Both native selectors are applied to every hybrid. NLL and KL are distinct.
Standard base-model RC format from official implementation, fixed dev5, identical inputs across conditions. Physical component interventions are not prompt behavior probes.
Same pinned tokenizer and uint32 token bytes across lineage. Native calibration and task replay agree exactly.
No model, seed, mask, subject or question selected by observed performance. Three lineage positions are not counted as independent initializations.
Same architecture and 31+1 expert budget in matched pruning conditions. Zeroing tests necessity, not equal-compute method rankings. Source effects are not responsibility percentages.

Dev/validation/test exact-overlap checks passed; independent task inputs supplement exploratory language windows. Pretraining benchmark contamination is unknown, so no uncontaminated capability or population claim.
Complete preregistered matrices and both metrics reported. Simple source contrasts were specified by the 2x2 card; calibration overlap is POST-HOC and does not support promotion.
Mathematics raw baseline is weak and cannot establish broad reasoning recovery. Biology baseline is above chance; paired macro and per-subject results retained. Poor hybrid full quality is explicit.

Claim is within this public mature lineage, frozen interface and input conditions. Author-declared ancestry lacks byte-level optimizer/batch chain. Training mechanism, unique unit and initialization-population claims remain open.

scope: Learned computation and source compatibility in this mature lineage: routing-parameter provenance alone does not carry budget robustness; real task effects and late dependency reorganization are observed. This is not an L3 independent review or L4 formation-mechanism conclusion.
